summary: Assist Custer County SAR with search for a missing 37-year-old male in the Crestones area (Alpine mission 13-89)
responding_agency: Custer County SAR; Alpine Rescue Team (assist)
notes: One-line mission-log alert; outcome not reported in post | AVSAR (Alamosa Volunteer SAR) was asked 2013-09-22 by COSAR to assist this same search (37yo male missing since 2013-09-17, staging near West Cliff) but declined: no members available.
